reference.purpose: test-only differential reference; never a consumer runtime

method.timer: perf_counter; instrumentation enabled equally on both runtimes; cold subprocess per sample
method.isolation_audit: Windows CIM inventory before and after every worker; concurrent test/benchmark/profile runners abort the measurement
method.memory: working set before/after plus 10ms sampled working-set peak; cumulative process peak and its growth per operation; samples may miss shorter spikes; not an allocation profiler
method.identity_entries: counted from executed full-scan/index-build length, not an estimated complexity ratio
method.fixture: calculations: up to 24 shared global rules in a chain, 5/15/35 technologies, remaining canonical features, one file per element; workflow: up to 24 independent global rules and the additional elements packed in one multi-block canonical Markdown; all literal context retained
method.equivalence: PYTHONHASHSEED=0, seeded generated UUIDs/fixed generation timestamp; same absolute fixture and trusted roots; all result fields hashed canonically
method.scope: public library prepare and apply with real Git, guards, staging and recoverable journal; no assistant/host token measurement
